name: oc-fn-tools
description: Functional/product toolkit for Opencell — Jira INTRD issue authoring (oc-fn-func-design), Confluence docs-space authoring (oc-fn-documentation), Playwright-driven Opencell Portal navigation & screenshots (oc-fn-portal), the design-first phased delivery methodology (oc-fn-project-management), branded slide-deck authoring & rendering with the Opencell Marp theme (oc-fn-decks), branded one-pager / note / brief authoring & PDF rendering (oc-fn-briefs), and GUI/screen design against the Opencell Figma design system (oc-fn-gui-design). Bundles a headless Playwright MCP server (oc-fn-playwright).
author: Stéphane Chambrin
